newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water sets retail 5.20 pct top yield in 2018.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water sets retail 5.20 pct top yield in 2018.

text.p: New York City Water Finance Authority on Friday said it set a top yield of 5.20 percent in 2018 for $56 million of bonds being offered to retail investors in a pre-sale period that ends on Monday.

The exact size of the debt sale has yet to be finalized, though at present it is estimated at almost $365.5 million. "Depending on where interest rates are, these amounts will change," said an Authority official, who declined to be named.
